title: Eagle B0 ticket and documentation control
overall: Jira filter 19455 contains 100 tickets: 67 To Do, 14 In Progress and 19 Pre-silicon Done. The four requested Level 1 areas account for 50 tickets in the current mapping: SDK 2, Host SW 28, AI Model Dev. Tools for Eagle N 9 and Ref. Models 11. No ticket is currently recorded as Resolved or Done in the filter capture. Three overdue Jira tickets and one missing assignee require management review. The new documentation sheet contributes 24 SRS/SAD/SUD writing and review pairs; direct Jira reads are used for those document keys even when they are outside filter 19455.
attention: Review the three overdue Jira tickets and agree an owner and recovery date.
Assign the one Host SW ticket without a Jira assignee before using its date as a commitment.
Add or confirm the missing Ref. Models Jira due date.
Confirm the 24 documentation writing/review pairs and keep review status and reviewer assignment visible after each writing ticket reaches Jira P-D.
Use the seven ITCP-47 child test requests as the test-request evidence set for P-D feature follow-up; wording-based matches remain review aids until a human confirms the relationship.

documentation.writingReviewRule: When a writing ticket is Jira P-D, its paired review ticket must be In Progress and assigned.

limitations: Jira status and due dates are the current ticket evidence. Workbook P-D and Done dates are targets and support mapping; they do not prove completion. Documentation controls read document ticket keys directly because not all of them carry the filter label. No Jira status, assignee or link is changed by this dashboard. Refresh remains on request through Codex.
